notes_for_editor: Single secondary source: a Canada Lookouts page quoting a 15 May 1948 Winnipeg Free Press item and an April 1968 Pas Herald notice. The record's built year of 1948 rests on the item saying construction was being completed that May. The 85-foot height is the item's figure for the tower; it does not say whether that is to the cab floor, so height_m may need checking. The record's point is the author's map placement, and no source checked it. No Manitoba register entry (NHLR or FFLOS) was found. The 1968 entry is a towerman recruitment notice, so no staffing status is recorded; nothing says whether the tower was ever staffed.
